1. (Currently Amended) A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, a __specifically identified__ functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a __pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of a specifically identified functional derivative__ of BH4 or its derivative or precursor; and (B) an __identified__ inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a __specifically identified pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof__, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

2. (Currently Amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a __specifically identified__ functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a __pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of a specifically identified functional derivative__ of BH4 or its derivative or precursor, an __identified__ inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a __specifically identified pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof__, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

3. (Currently Amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a __specifically identified__ functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a __pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of a specifically identified functional derivative__ of BH4 or its derivative or precursor, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an __identified__ inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII, or a __specifically identified pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof__, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

6. (Currently Amended) A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the component that is BH4 or a __specifically identified__ functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof is a compound of formula I, O R HN R2 N R3 R -N N N R4 H R5 R wherein R1 and R2 either independently represent H or C12 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; R3 represents aryl or C1.4 alkyl, which alkyl group is optionally substituted by one or more substituents selected from aryl, OR7 and oxo; R7 represents, independently at each occurrence, H or C(O)R8; R8 represents C1..4 alkyl, aryl, C1.4 alkoxy and C1.4 alkylamino; R4 and R5 either independently represent H or C1-2 alkyl, or together represent a bond between the C- and N-atoms to which they are attached; and R6 represents H or C(O)-C131 alkyl.

13. (Currently Amended) A combination product as claimed in any one of the preceding claims, wherein the identified inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII is a __specifically identified__ renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor or an AT1 receptor antagonist.

14. (Currently Amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 13, wherein the __identified__ inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of AII is a compound selected from the group consisting of __specifically identified__ aliskiren, ditekiren, enalkiren, remikiren, terlakiren, zankiren, benazepril, captopril, cilazapril, enalapril, fosinopril, lisinopril, moexepril, perindopril, quinapril, ramipril, trandolapril, candesartan, eprosartan, irbesartan, losartan, olmesartan, telmisartan, tasosartan, valsartan, ciclosidomine, furosemide, and saralasin.
